card.text: Explore the primary of 2001 SN263 through its archived radar shape.

introduction.text: 2001 SN263 Alpha is the primary of the triple asteroid system 2001 SN263. Published radar and light-curve shape of the primary. Fine terrain and visible-light color are unresolved; the grid marks missing imagery. The archive includes weakly observed model regions. Rotational phase is illustrative. Heliocentric placement uses a retained JPL state. The shape is a radar reconstruction from 2008 observations.
